title.zh: 批准将第1849号共和国法授予Butuan Sawmill, Inc.的特许权转让给南苏里高省Lianga市镇政府的法案
title.en: An Act Approving Any Assignment, Sale and Transfer of the Franchise Granted to Butuan Sawmill, Inc. Under Republic Act Numbered Eighteen Hundred Forty-Nine, in Favor of the Municipal Government of Lianga, Province of Surigao del Sur
title.orig: An Act Approving Any Assignment, Sale and Transfer of the Franchise Granted to Butuan Sawmill, Inc. Under Republic Act Numbered Eighteen Hundred Forty-Nine, in Favor of the Municipal Government of Lianga, Province of Surigao del Sur

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_3994_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions prescribed in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred thirty-six, and to the provisions of the Constitution, approval is hereby given to any assignment, sale and transfer of the franchise granted to Butuan Sawmill, Inc., to install, operate and maintain an electric light, heat and power system in the Municipality of Lianga, Province of Surigao del Sur, under Republic Act Numbered Eighteen hundred forty-nine, in favor of the Municipal Government of Lianga, Province of Surigao del Sur, together with all the property and equipment acquired thereunder.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1964.
